rationale: GAV_BDC02 fired because extracted BDC investment fair value of 184.466 million is 0.724 of the total-assets proxy of 254.797 million. The raw schedule confirms that 184.466 million is exactly the filing's Total Investments, while the filing separately presents a 49.798 million U.S. Treasury Bill cash equivalent and Total Investments & Cash Equivalents of 234.264 million. The low ratio is therefore caused by comparing investments-only holdings to full-fund total assets while excluding cash equivalents, not by an incorrect extracted fair value.
